```{r}
#| results: hide

source("../config.R")

# general 
library(tidyverse) 
library(ggthemes)
library(cmocean)
library(cowplot)
```

# Data

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# projects
proj <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_projects.csv"),
                 col_select=c("projid","title","title_code"))

# samples
sp <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples+acquisitions_cleaned.csv")) %>%
  distinct(projid,genid,sampleid,longitude,latitude,depth_max,date) %>%
  left_join(proj)

# objects 
obj <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_objects_morpho_taxo_cleaned.csv"),
                col_select=c("objid","sampleid","grey_median","acquisid","grey_std")) %>% 
  left_join(sp)
```

# Map

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# Define a simple gray-scale world map
map_bck <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = map_data("world"), aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group), 
  fill = "#E8E8E8", color = "grey90", size = 0.3) +  # light gray background and borders
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#D0D0D0", linetype = "dotted", size = 0.4),  # Light, subtle grid
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),  # Transparent background
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray20"), # Latitude and longitude labels
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")  # Legend at the bottom

# plot sp 
plot_sp <- sp %>% 
  group_by(genid,latitude,longitude,title_code,date) %>% 
  filter(depth_max==max(depth_max)) 

# Plot points with custom colors and slight transparency
map_bck + 
  geom_point(aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color=depth_max,shape = title_code,), 
             data = plot_sp, 
             size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(8,17,15,18,16,3)) + 
  scale_color_cmocean(name="deep") +
  # longitude labels
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-200, 200, by = 50), limits = c(-180, 180),
                     labels = function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "0°", sprintf("%d°%s", abs(x), ifelse(x < 0, "W", "E")))) + 
  # latitude labels
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 50), limits = c(-90, 90),
                     labels = function(y) ifelse(y == 0, "0°", sprintf("%d°%s", abs(y), ifelse(y < 0, "S", "N")))) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(shape = "", color="Tow depth \n        (m)") +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2))
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(cfg$project$figures,"Fig2a.tiff"),dpi=300,width=7,height=4)
```

Depth percentage below 200m:

```{r}
sp %>% 
  distinct(genid,depth_max) %>% 
  add_count() %>% 
  filter(depth_max < 210) %>% 
  group_by(n) %>% 
  summarize(less200=n()) %>% 
  mutate(perc=less200*100/n)
```

# Latitude distribution

```{r}
plot_sp %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(month=month(date,label=TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) %>% 
  # bins
  mutate(
    lat_bin = cut(latitude, breaks = seq(-90,90, by = 10), include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE),
    lon_bin = cut(longitude, breaks = seq(-180,180, by = 20), include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  count(lat_bin,month) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=month,y=lat_bin,fill=n)) +
  geom_tile(color= "white",size=0.1) + 
  scale_fill_cmocean(name="thermal") +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x="",y="Latitude",fill="# samples") + 
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(cfg$project$figures,"Fig2b.tiff"),dpi=300,width=4,height=4)
```

# Projects table

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
tb <- obj %>% 
  group_by(ecotaxaID=projid,project=title_code,campaign=title) %>% 
  summarize(samples=n_distinct(genid),images=n_distinct(objid)) %>% 
  # adjust the project
  mutate(project=ifelse(str_detect(project,"Tara"),"Tara",project)) %>% 
  mutate(project=factor(project,levels=c("Tara","Apero","Tonga","Triatlas","Creocean"))) %>% 
  # arrange properly
  arrange(project,desc(project)) %>% 
  # add person in charge column
  mutate(contact=case_when(str_detect(campaign,"Tara|TONGA|APERO")~"lombard@imev-mer.fr",
                           str_detect(campaign,"Creocean")~"legall@creocean.fr",
                           str_detect(campaign,"Triatlas")~"rkiko@geomar.de")) %>% 
  # reorder columns
  relocate(ecotaxaID,project,campaign,`#samples`=samples,`#images`=images,contact)

tb
```

# Ranges

Individual grey values range:

```{r}
summary(obj$grey_median)
```

Zooplankton community ranges (weighted mean of the median values):

```{r}
density <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples+acquisitions_cleaned.csv")) %>%
  distinct(acquisid,d) 

obj %>% 
  left_join(density) %>% 
  group_by(genid) %>%
  mutate(gmedian=sum(grey_median*d)/sum(d)) %>% 
  summary()
```
